scripts.db:reset: env -u SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD npx supabase db reset
scripts.db:types: env -u SUPABASE_DB_PASSWORD npx supabase gen types typescript --local --schema public > packages/shared/src/types/database.tmp && (echo '// Généré par `pnpm db:types` (supabase gen types) — ne pas modifier à la main.'; cat packages/shared/src/types/database.tmp) > packages/shared/src/types/database.ts && rm packages/shared/src/types/database.tmp
scripts.e2e:local: bash scripts/local-env.sh pnpm --filter @nextin/web build && bash scripts/local-env.sh pnpm --filter @nextin/web test:e2e
